heading: Wednesday, October 7, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 and OpenAI GPT-6 (ChatGPT).

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's small model for high-volume, latency-sensitive work and the first Haiku with an adjustable effort setting. It is priced from $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens, and Anthropic says it costs about 75% less to run on average than Haiku 4.5.

items.headline: OpenAI brings GPT-6 and Intelligent UI to all ChatGPT users
items.summary: OpenAI rolled out October versions of GPT-6 Sol (paid tiers) and GPT-6 Luna (Free and Go) to ChatGPT's Chat tab, replacing the GPT-5.6 models, along with Intelligent UI responses that can include charts, forms and interactive elements. OpenAI says GPT-6 Instant starts answering search queries 44% sooner than GPT-5.6 Instant.
